'''Jeffers''' was a [[colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Promotion" /> At one point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Colonel Jeffers served as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] attempt to occupy the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]]. At Irrv's initiative, a ceremony was arranged to peacefully transfer power from the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Culroon]] and their leader, [[Kloff]], to the Empire.<ref name="Promotion" /> The process was to be symbolized with an exchange of a ceremonial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and a [[Naval sword]].<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|31|VEE 1-2|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref>

Jeffers attended the ceremony with Irrv, other [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], and a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], along with Kloff and a dozen Culroon [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. When Irrv presented Kloff with the Naval [[Sword/Legends|sword]], Kloff calmly impaled Jeffers<ref name="Promotion" /> in the chest<ref name="Fact File" />&mdash;[[Death/Legends|killing]] him<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;and launching an [[Insurrection on Culroon III|insurrection]] against the Empire. The Imperials were saved by an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] commanded by [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]].<ref name="Promotion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jeffers first appeared in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[West End Games]]' [[1987]] ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Promotion" />
